# First Then Board (first-then.app)

> First Then Board is a free First-Then board that runs in the web browser. It shows two picture cards, "First" a task and "Then" something the child wants, and is made for parents, teachers and therapists who support children with autism, ADHD, speech and language needs, and toddlers. There is no account, and all boards and photos stay on the user's device.

Made by: Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska (Apps for Parents). Contact: appsforparents@gmail.com
Website: https://first-then.app/
Type: web app (not an App Store app). Language: English.
Price: the simple board is free. Extras are locked and can be unlocked free for one day at a time; nothing is sold on the site yet (planned price for a one-time unlock: $9.99). No account, no ads.

## What it is

- A First-Then board shows two pictures side by side: First a task, Then something the child wants. Example: "First shoes, then park."
- It makes the day predictable and gives a child a clear reason to start a hard task. It is often the first step before a full visual schedule.
- Used by parents, teachers and therapists for autism, ADHD, speech therapy and with toddlers.
- It opens in the browser on a phone, a tablet or a computer. Nothing to download, no sign-up.

## Key features

- Cards: each card has a picture and a word. The picture can be an icon or your own photo. A card can also be text only.
- Icons: 80 icons in 5 groups (Routines, School, Food, Play, Rewards), with search. 20 icons are free; the others are an extra. The icons are the device's own emoji.
- Extras and "free for today": some features are locked extras (adding your own photos, the icons outside the free 20, the third card, more boards and ready-made boards, printing a board with its pictures). One tap on "Unlock free for today" opens all extras until midnight, at no cost, with no payment, email or account. It can be repeated on any day. Boards and photos already made always stay usable.
- Own photos (extra): take a photo with the camera or choose one from the device, then crop it to a square. Photos are made smaller on the device and saved in "My photos" to use again on any card.
- Done: tap the First card when the task is done. It gets a check mark and a short confetti celebration, and the Then card lights up.
- First-Then-Next (extra): an optional third card for children who are ready to see one more step.
- Pairs: prepare several First-Then pairs in a row. The child sees one pair at a time, and "Next" moves to the following pair.
- Several boards (extra): the app starts with one board, "My board". In the Boards dialog a new board can start empty or from one of four ready-made boards with First-Then pairs: Morning, Bedtime, School or Meals. With two or more boards, tap the board name above the cards to switch.
- Full screen (child mode): shows only the board, with no editing. Exit by holding the close button for about one second. The screen stays on in full screen where the browser supports it. On iPad the full screen button works in Safari. On iPhone, full screen works only when the board is opened from the Home Screen icon.
- Big text: larger words on the cards.
- Print: "Blank template" is free and prints empty First and Then cards (and a Next card in 3-card mode) with space for a picture and a line for the word, to fill in by hand. Printing one pair or all pairs with their icons and photos (each pair on its own page, in landscape) is an extra.
- Printable PDFs: free blank templates to download from https://first-then.app/printable/ (blank First-Then board, blank First-Then-Next board, a cut-out sheet of First / Then / Next label cards; A4 and US Letter each; black and white; no sign-up).
- Backup: export all boards and photos to one file, and import it on another device or browser.
- Add to Home Screen: the board can be added to the Home Screen of a phone or tablet and opened like an app.
- Offline: after the first visit the board is saved in the browser and opens without an internet connection.

## How to make a First-Then board

1. Choose the task: tap the pencil on the First card and pick an icon, take a photo, or type a word for one small task.
2. Choose the reward: tap the pencil on the Then card and put something there that the child really wants.
3. Add more pairs if needed, with the plus button under the cards.
4. Show the board on the screen, or open the menu and choose Print for a paper board.

## Why First-Then works

- The idea is called the Premack principle: first the less-wanted task, then the wanted one. The thing a child likes to do becomes the reason to start the harder thing.
- When to move on: when the child follows First-Then (and First-Then-Next) calmly most of the time, try a full visual schedule that shows more steps of the day.
- How to fade the board out: little by little. Show it only for the hard moments, later just say "first..., then...", and stop when the child no longer needs it.

## Privacy

- All boards, card words and photos are stored only on the user's device, in the browser's storage (IndexedDB).
- Boards are never uploaded. Photos never leave the device.
- No account, no cookies, no ads.
- The site counts anonymous usage events (for example how often Print is used) with TelemetryDeck, to improve the app. No cookies are set. The board counts on the device how many days it was used (it needs this for the "Add to Home Screen" tip); only a rough group (1, 2-3, 4-7 or 8+ days) is sent, together with rough groups for the number of boards and photos.
- Card words, board names and photos never leave the device.

## Pages

- [First Then Board](https://first-then.app/): the board itself, why First-Then works, how to make and use a First-Then board, example pairs, how to print it, tips for autism, ADHD and toddlers, and an FAQ.
- [Free printable First-Then board (PDF)](https://first-then.app/printable/): six free PDF files to download (blank First-Then board, blank First-Then-Next board, First / Then / Next label cards; A4 and US Letter each), how to use a blank chart, how to make it last, printer settings.
- [First-Then-Next board](https://first-then.app/first-then-next/): what the 3-card board is, when a child is ready for the third card, what to put on the Next card, how to move from two cards to three, examples.
- [First-Then board for autism](https://first-then.app/autism/): why it helps, how to start, real photos or icons, common mistakes, what to do when a child refuses, how to fade the board out, home and school.
- [First-Then board for toddlers](https://first-then.app/toddlers/): how small the task should be, rewards that work, potty training, tantrums, examples, mistakes to avoid.
- [First-Then chart, schedule or board](https://first-then.app/first-then-chart/): the different names of the same tool (first-then chart, first/then schedule, "first and then" board), what it looks like, 18 example pairs for the day, paper or screen, how to make one.
- [First-Then board in the classroom](https://first-then.app/classroom/): a teacher guide to where to put the board, how to introduce it to a student, classroom examples, whole-class use, common mistakes.
- [First-Then board for speech therapy and ABA](https://first-then.app/speech-therapy/): how to run a session with the board, session examples, words to model, online sessions, what to send home, use with a token board.
- [First-Then board vs visual schedule vs token board](https://first-then.app/first-then-vs-visual-schedule/): a comparison table (what each tool shows, steps shown, when to use it, typical age), when to use which, how to use them together, when to move on.
- [Privacy](https://first-then.app/privacy.html): what is saved on the device, which anonymous usage counts are sent, and what is never sent.

## FAQ

- Is it free? Yes. The simple board is free in the browser, with no account and no ads. Extras (own photos, more icons, a third card, more boards, printing with pictures) are locked, and one tap unlocks all of them free for today. Nothing is charged on the site.
- Where are my photos stored? Only on your device, inside the browser's storage. They are never uploaded to a server.
- Can my boards get lost? Yes, because they live only in that browser. Clearing the browser data deletes them, and Safari may delete site data after some days without a visit. To protect them, add the board to the Home Screen and export a backup from time to time.
- Can I print it? Yes. Open the menu and choose Print. "Blank template" prints empty cards to fill in by hand and is free. "This pair" and "All pairs" print the board with its pictures and are extras.
- Does it work offline? Yes, after the first visit. The board is saved in the browser, so it opens without internet.
- Is there an iPhone or iPad app? Not yet. First Then Board is a web app that works in the browser on iPhone and iPad.

## Related tools by the same maker

- [Visual Schedule Daily Routine](https://visual-schedule.app/): an iPhone, iPad and Mac app that shows a child's whole day as pictures. The next step when First-Then works well.
- [Token Board: ABA Reward Chart](https://token-board.app/): a token board and reward chart app, good for longer tasks and rewards.
- [Visual Timer for Kids](https://kidstimer.app/): a picture-reveal timer app that shows a child how much time is left.
